title: An old bookmark to the Catalog page opens the Part Library
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a bookmark, saved before this release, to the Catalog page (your ShopView address followed by /parts/parts-catalogue).
  • Start on any page of the app in the same browser.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The page opens without an error or a "page not found" message.
  • Its title reads "Part Library".
  • The browser's address bar still shows the bookmarked address: the page's address has not changed.
